title: phaseolus minimus f. lobatus
intro: Phaseolus minimus f. lobatus, commonly known as the "Mexican bean trefoil" or "small white bean," is a plant species in the legume family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus minimus f. lobatus are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, improve blood sugar control, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
